buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ​1. DOCUMENTS TO BE SUBMITTED WITH THE BID The bidder shall submit the following documents along with the bid: 1.1. Bank Account Details: Ø A cancelled cheque, or Ø Duly filled Bank Mandate Form, or Ø Copy of the passbook containing complete bank account details, including the account hold er's name, account number, IFSC code, bank name, and branch name. 1.2. UDYAM/MSME Certificate: A copy of the valid UDYAM Registration Certificate or MSME Certific ate, if applicable. 1.3. PAN Card: A copy of the bidder's PAN card. 1.4. GST Registration Certificate: A copy of the bidder's GST Registration Certificate, if applicable. 1.5. Undertaking Regarding Debarment/Blacklisting: Duly filled and signed Certificate as per An nexure-I. 2. ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR PAYMENT 2.1. The quoted rates shall be inclusive of all costs, including packing, forwarding, freight, transportat ion, loading, unloading, and cartage, as applicable. No separate payment shall be made on these accounts. 2.2. Applicable Tax Deducted at Source (TDS), if any, shall be deducted from the payments in accord ance with the prevailing statutory provisions. 3. SCOPE OF WORK

3.1. The content to be printed in the Registers/Books are detailed in Annexure-III to Annexure-VII. 3.2. All Registers/Books shall be printed in Landscape orientation. 3.3. The layout and printing shall be arranged in such a manner that, after binding, adequate space is available for convenient writing and recording of details in the respective Registers/Books. 3.4. The successful bidder shall submit samples of all items, strictly conforming to the specifications detailed in Annexure-III to Annexure-VII, within 10 days from the date of issue of the Supply Order through GeM, for verification and approval of the material, content, layout, printing quality, etc., before commencement of the final printing. 3.5. The Service Provider shall ensure complete delivery of all Registers/Books, in the required quanti ties as specified in Annexure-II, at the designated delivery location within 20 days from the dat e of approval of the samples by the Buyer. Partial supply shall not be treated as completion of the order. 3.6. The printed materials shall strictly conform to the specifications, quality, type of paper, printing r equirements, and other conditions specified in the bid. Any material found to be defective or devi ating from the specified requirements may be rejected by the buyer. The rejected material shall b e replaced by the service provider at no additional cost to the buyer (i.e. Airports Authority of Indi a, Bhavnagar). 3.7. The bidder shall print and supply the required quantities of each Registers/Books as specified An nexure-II of this ATC. 3.8. Conditional bids shall be summarily rejected. Note: In all matters related to this bid, the decision of the Airport Director, AAI Bhavnagar shall be final an d binding on all bidders. The Airport Director, AAI Bhavnagar reserves all the rights to accept or reject any or all bids, without assigning any reasons, thereof.​ . 3.
